Ym.bar_b_note: Flat noon light with no fog, single mid-tone sand and dark banded water stripes sink it; B's small gazebo/hut on the crest is a start but too small and isolated to carry a named place.

Kg.bar_b_note: Trees, banner camp and the distant waterfall stack give some place, but uniform grass carpet, pebble scatter and atmosphere-free hard light keep it well below Palworld density and Valheim mood.

Gk.bar_b_note: Sheer featureless sand walls with a vertical cut fill most of stand 09 and the even grass grid looks generated; B's watchtower and stilt house help but stay small against empty dunes.

Ml.bar_b_note: A clean, readable stylised elder with warm expressive face, white hair and a coherent green/brown villager palette that sits comfortably beside Palworld characters, though the face is softer and more cartoon than the world.

Th.bar_b_note: B's timber frame, diagonal brace, plank cap and stone footing finally read as construction, but a single free-standing flat-infill panel still looks like a placeholder door/outhouse, not a Palworld-grade base piece.

Gx.bar_b_note: Long bare sand slopes with stray low-poly boulders and pebble scatter dominate; B's house sits canted on the stand 11 slope and the tower is small, so no landmark carries the frame.

Gn.bar_b_note: The waterfall sea-stack and blue banners give the best Tidewake read in the batch and B's stilt huts add a settlement, but dark navy water bands, flat sand and no aerial haze keep it short of the same finish.

Sv.bar_b_note: B's crab creature and tower/huts bring life, but stand 19 is an empty sand bowl, the lone wooden cabinet prop on the crest reads as random, and the light has no atmosphere.

Rb.bar_b_note: A's purple-blue lightning wolf matches the Tanglevolt style bar, but B's faint frames lose the material entirely to white with black blotches, which breaks the creature at the same finish.

Bf.bar_b_note: A heavy plated boar with good scale and tusks, but A's dark-brown-on-black plates go muddy and the faint end turns almost pure black; B's ember cracks add value contrast yet the whole body still reads low-key against the stage.

top_changes.change: Compose every named Tidewake location around one large focal building or landmark cluster (scale buildings up 1.5-2x, place them centred in both camera stands with paths, docks, fences and banners leading to them), and replace the even grass carpet and pebble scatter with grouped dune-grass clumps and cleared sand paths.

Give Tidewake real light and value structure: warmer time-of-day grade, aerial haze for distance, sand albedo/wetness variation at the waterline and shadowed dune faces, and remove the dark navy banding stripes on the water.
Fix creature material states in hurt/faint poses (Rb side B white-and-black texture loss, Bf side A faint end going pure black) and lift creature rim light so silhouettes separate from the stage.
